summary_ja: Discovery CAARについて、Frontier基準FOM、最低5倍の加速計画、年0.5 FTE程度、early hardware、vendor共同支援、中間・最終報告を一体化したapplication readiness制度を追加しました。5倍は計画要件であり実測達成値ではなく、単一モデルによる暫定調査でConsensusは未完了です。
summary_en: For Discovery CAAR, this update adds an application-readiness process combining a Frontier-baselined FOM, an at-least-fivefold acceleration plan, roughly 0.5 FTE per year, early hardware, joint vendor support, and interim and final reporting. Fivefold is a planning requirement rather than a measured result. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

sections.title_ja: Discovery CAARの性能目標とアプリケーション準備制度
sections.title_en: Performance targets and application-readiness process for Discovery CAAR
sections.summary_ja: 次期systemの性能予測を、基準機で測るFigure of Merit、加速目標、人員、早期hardware、vendor支援、最終報告まで一続きの検証計画として扱います。
sections.summary_en: Treat next-system performance forecasts as an end-to-end validation plan covering a baseline figure of merit, acceleration target, staffing, early hardware, vendor support, and final reporting.

items.name_ja: Frontier基準FOMと最低5倍の加速計画
items.name_en: Frontier-baselined FOM and at-least-fivefold acceleration plan
items.timing_en: Selected in 2026; Discovery deployment scheduled for 2028
items.statement_ja: OLCFのDiscovery CAAR公募は、modeling/simulation、data-intensive、workflow、AI applicationを対象に、challenge problemを定め、Figure of Merit（FOM）をFrontierで測定し、Discoveryで最低5倍へ加速する計画の提示を求めています。選定teamにはFrontier、early hardware、Discovery早期利用、OLCFとHPE/AMD Center of Excellenceによるprofiling・porting・最適化支援が提供されます。最低5倍は応募時の計画要件であり、2028年の実測達成値ではありません。Discoveryのnode性能とsystem規模も現時点で非公開です。
items.statement_en: The OLCF Discovery CAAR call covers modeling and simulation, data-intensive, workflow, and AI applications. Teams must define a challenge problem, measure a Figure of Merit (FOM) on Frontier, and provide a plan for at least fivefold acceleration on Discovery. Selected teams receive Frontier allocations, early hardware, early Discovery access, and profiling, porting, and optimization support from OLCF and the HPE/AMD Center of Excellence. The fivefold figure is a proposal-stage planning requirement, not a measured 2028 result. Discovery node performance and system size are also not yet public.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCI次期機でもpeak性能倍率だけを要求せず、代表applicationごとに現行機のFOM、目標倍率、科学的妥当性、投入人員、early access、最終実測を一つの移行契約として管理する参考になります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: For successor HPCI systems, this supports managing the current-system FOM, target gain, scientific validity, staffing, early access, and final measurement for each representative application as one readiness contract rather than requiring only a peak-performance multiplier.
adoption_conditions_ja: FOMの式、入力、scale、precision、baseline system、software版、測定区間を公開可能な範囲で固定する。
計画値、予測値、early hardware実測、acceptance後実測を別欄で保存する。
性能倍率と同時に解の妥当性、energy、移植工数、保守負担を判定する。
adoption_conditions_en: Pin the FOM formula, input, scale, precision, baseline system, software version, and timed region to the extent publishable.
Store planning targets, forecasts, early-hardware measurements, and post-acceptance measurements separately.
Evaluate scientific validity, energy, porting effort, and maintenance burden alongside performance gain.

items.name_ja: 人員commitmentと中間・最終報告を含むreadiness gate
items.name_en: Readiness gate with staffing commitments and interim and final reports
items.timing_en: First nine projects selected in June 2026
items.statement_ja: CAAR公募はcode teamに年0.5 FTE程度の担当を推奨し、中間報告と、Discovery上のchallenge problem・FOM結果を記す最終報告を課します。9件は科学的進展、他分野への移転可能性、teamのcommitment、FOM・加速計画、programming model・algorithm・AIへの寄与で選定されました。公開頁が示すALF、S3D-Regent、GENESIS、PIConGPU、SPARC等の説明は想定scienceと方法であり、まだDiscovery上の完了結果ではありません。
items.statement_en: The CAAR call recommends roughly 0.5 FTE per year from each code team and requires interim reports plus a final report documenting the challenge problem and FOM results on Discovery. Nine projects were selected on scientific potential, transferability, team commitment, FOM and acceleration plans, and contributions to programming models, algorithms, and AI. The public descriptions of ALF, S3D-Regent, GENESIS, PIConGPU, SPARC, and other projects state intended science and methods, not completed results on Discovery.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: application readinessを機器納入後の無償努力に依存させず、共同設計期間、人員、成果物、秘密保持と公開範囲を調達・整備計画に組み込むべきことを示します。
items.hpci_relevance_en: This indicates that application readiness should not depend on unpaid post-delivery effort; co-design periods, staffing, deliverables, confidentiality, and publication scope should be part of procurement and deployment planning.
adoption_conditions_ja: 代表分野の偏り、OSSへの還元、各centerへの移転可能性を選定基準に含める。
FTE、vendor支援時間、early hardware枠、report、公開可能成果を契約で定義する。
NDA内の結果と公開検証可能な結果を分離し、公開側には根拠境界を示す。
adoption_conditions_en: Include disciplinary coverage, upstream open-source contribution, and transferability across centers in selection criteria.
Define FTEs, vendor-support hours, early-hardware allocations, reports, and publishable outputs contractually.
Separate NDA-bound results from publicly reproducible results and expose the evidence boundary on the public side.
